Arsenicum  album.


Symptoms.

Generalities,

Burning  pain  of  exterior  parts....


inner  parts

by  moving  the  affected  part.

Weakness

Trembling  of  the  limbs,  (in  drunk-
ards).

Emaciation

Deficiency  of  blood

Swelling,  in  general

Dropsy  of  external  parts

internal  parts

Inflammation  of  external  parts...

of  mucus  membranes

Coldness  of  all  the  limbs

Paralysis

especially  of  the  lower  extremities.

(feet)

He  cannot  rest  in  any  place — chan-
ges his  position  continually  —
wants  to  go  from  one  bed  to  an-
other—and lies  now  here  and  then
there.

Burning  in  the  glands
